h1.en: Accuracy as percent of Rate is the heading; fine stone or aggregate distance row on the order stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「准确度 as 相对读数的百分比」，主体仍是邢台泵的订单上该写哪一行距离

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for fine stone or aggregate distance row on the order. The row to open is /products/electric-30-concrete-pump. its 24 mm pair is 100 m / 300 m. Diesel 30 prints one pair, 60 m / 180 m. Electric 20 prints one pair, 120 m / 40 m. Electric 80 prints one pair, 900 m / 300 m. Electric 60’s fine-stone pair is 200 m / 600 m. Electric 40’s pairs are 120 m / 360 m and 40 m / 120 m. Writing only “360 m” does not say which row you buy against. The sheet used here prints one fine-stone pair, 80 m / 240 m. Electric 30’s fine-stone pair is 60 m / 180 m and its aggregate-13 pair is 20 m / 60 m. HBT80-16 does not use that pair style: it prints horizontal conveying 120 m and delivery height 360 m as separate labels. Electric 50, Electric 60, Electric Low Pressure 60 and the diesel mixer print fine stone (or ≤ 1 inch on the diesel mixer), then 13 mm, then 24 mm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints split distance rows on Electric 30, Electric 40, Electric 50, Electric 60, Electric Low Pressure 60 and the diesel mixer. The section title “Accuracy as Percent of Full Span” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是邢台泵的订单上该写哪一行距离的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-30-concrete-pump。柴油30只有一组 60 m / 180 m。电动20只有一组 120 m / 40 m。24 mm 是 100 m / 300 m。电动60的细石是 200 m / 600 m.电动80只有一组 900 m / 300 m。只写“360 m”并没有说明你对照的是哪一行。此处使用的表只印一组细石 80 m / 240 m。电动40是 120 m / 360 m 和 40 m / 120 m。电动30的细石是 60 m / 180 m，13 骨料是 20 m / 60 m。HBT80-16 不用这种成对写法：它把水平输送 120 m 和输送高度 360 m 分成两个标题。河北品锦机械（邢台）在电动30、电动40、电动50、电动60、电动低压60和柴油搅拌泵上印了分行距离。电动50、电动60、电动低压60和柴油搅拌泵印有细石（柴油搅拌泵写 ≤ 1 英寸），然后是 13 mm，然后是 24 mm。节标题「准确度 as 百分比的满量程」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

heading.en: Accuracy as Percent of Full Span
heading.zh: 准确度 as 百分比的满量程

body.en: “Accuracy as Percent of Full Span” titles this part of the fine stone or aggregate distance row on the order note. The figures stay the printed ones. its 24 mm pair is 100 m / 300 m. Electric 60’s fine-stone pair is 200 m / 600 m. Electric 30’s fine-stone pair is 60 m / 180 m and its aggregate-13 pair is 20 m / 60 m.
body.zh: 「准确度 as 百分比的满量程」是邢台泵的订单上该写哪一行距离这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。24 mm 是 100 m / 300 m。电动60的细石是 200 m / 600 m.柴油30只有一组 60 m / 180 m。

heading.zh: 准确度 as 相对读数的百分比

body.en: For fine stone or aggregate distance row on the order, the heading “Accuracy as percent of Rate” does not replace a cell. Diesel 30 prints one pair, 60 m / 180 m. Electric 40’s pairs are 120 m / 360 m and 40 m / 120 m. HBT80-16 does not use that pair style: it prints horizontal conveying 120 m and delivery height 360 m as separate labels.
body.zh: 对邢台泵的订单上该写哪一行距离而言，标题「准确度 as 相对读数的百分比」并不替换任何格子。电动30的细石是 60 m / 180 m，13 骨料是 20 m / 60 m。电动20只有一组 120 m / 40 m。HBT80-16 不用这种成对写法：它把水平输送 120 m 和输送高度 360 m 分成两个标题。

body.en: fine stone or aggregate distance row on the order is unchanged by the heading “Hysteresis”. Electric 20 prints one pair, 120 m / 40 m. Writing only “360 m” does not say which row you buy against. Electric 50, Electric 60, Electric Low Pressure 60 and the diesel mixer print fine stone (or ≤ 1 inch on the diesel mixer), then 13 mm, then 24 mm.
body.zh: 邢台泵的订单上该写哪一行距离不因标题「滞后」而改动。电动40是 120 m / 360 m 和 40 m / 120 m。只写“360 m”并没有说明你对照的是哪一行。电动50、电动60、电动低压60和柴油搅拌泵印有细石（柴油搅拌泵写 ≤ 1 英寸），然后是 13 mm，然后是 24 mm。

body.en: This section is titled “Standard Deviation Estimate”. fine stone or aggregate distance row on the order still prints the cells below. Electric 80 prints one pair, 900 m / 300 m. The sheet used here prints one fine-stone pair, 80 m / 240 m. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints split distance rows on Electric 30, Electric 40, Electric 50, Electric 60, Electric Low Pressure 60 and the diesel mixer. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/flowmeters-accuaracy-d_657.html.
body.zh: 本节标题是「标准差 估计」。邢台泵的订单上该写哪一行距离下面这些格子仍是印出来的。电动80只有一组 900 m / 300 m。此处使用的表只印一组细石 80 m / 240 m。河北品锦机械（邢台）在电动30、电动40、电动50、电动60、电动低压60和柴油搅拌泵上印了分行距离。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/flowmeters-accuaracy-d_657.html。

question.en: Does “Accuracy as Percent of Full Span” replace its 24 mm pair is 100 m / 300 m?
question.zh: 「准确度 as 百分比的满量程」会替换「柴油30只有一组 60 m / 180 m。」吗？

answer.en: No. its 24 mm pair is 100 m / 300 m remains the printed wording for fine stone or aggregate distance row on the order.
answer.zh: 不会。柴油30只有一组 60 m / 180 m。仍是邢台泵的订单上该写哪一行距离已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Diesel 30 prints one pair, 60 m / 180 m belong on the fine stone or aggregate distance row on the order row?
question.zh: 邢台泵的订单上该写哪一行距离这一行里，「电动20只有一组 120 m / 40 m。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-30-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-30-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Accuracy as percent of Rate” add to fine stone or aggregate distance row on the order?
question.zh: 「准确度 as 相对读数的百分比」给邢台泵的订单上该写哪一行距离增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/flowmeters-accuaracy-d_657.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/flowmeters-accuaracy-d_657.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside its 24 mm pair is 100 m / 300 m?
